couple.invitationMessage: With the divine grace of Almighty Allah (SWT) and the cherished prayers of our beloved parents and elders, we request the honour of your gracious presence and heartfelt duas as we celebrate the sacred Nikah of our beloved children.
couple.urduGreeting: Aapki pur-khuloos shirkat aur duayein hamari khushiyon ko dobala karengi.

sacred.bismillahTranslation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful
sacred.surahVerse: And We created you in pairs
sacred.surahArRum: And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquility in them; and He placed between you affection and mercy.
sacred.propheticDua: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
sacred.propheticDuaTranslation: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and unite you both in goodness and eternal love.

venue.name: The Grand Qasr Al-Noor
venue.address: Al-Noor Palace Estate, Mughal Gardens, New Delhi, India

dressCode.title: Royal Mughal & Pastel Elegance
dressCode.description: We invite our honored guests to grace the evening in regal ethnic attire with shades of Emerald Green, Antique Gold, Soft Champagne, and Regal Ivory.

events.name: Manjha & Mayun Ceremony
events.description: A radiant golden morning of fragrant ubtan, fresh turmeric rituals, marigold showers, and joyful sisterly melodies.

events.name: Jashn-e-Mehendi & Sangeet
events.description: An enchanting evening of intricate henna artistry, soulful Sufi qawwali notes, traditional dholak beats, and celebration.

events.name: The Sacred Nikah (Ijab-o-Qubool)
events.description: Solemnization of marriage vows and Khutbah-e-Nikah under the celestial dome with sacred duas, surrounded by loved ones.

events.name: Rukhsati & Royal Walima
events.description: Tender parental blessings followed by an opulent Mughal banquet celebrating eternal love with gourmet delicacies and festivities.
